14523: One of the most popular boys at Seika High, Usui appears to take little interest in anything and prefers to observe things as they unfold, though proves to be extraordinarily talented in numerous areas.
14941: Misaki is the heroine of Kaichou wa Maid-sama!. She lives alone with her mother and her younger sister Suzuna, because her father abandoned them, leaving them with a huge debt.
16614: Satsuki's nephew, the son of Satsuki's older brother, and a junior high school student who enjoys dressing like a girl. He likes "cute things", and being the center of attention.
19286: The Vice President of the Student Council, Shouichirou Yukimura tries to help Misaki where he can, and enjoys office routine. At first, he, like the rest of the student council, is fearful of Misaki, but he eventually comes to be on fairly close terms with her and Usui.
19985: He is Misaki-chan's childhood friend. He can eat anything and still be hungry. He works at a gas station.
27667: A withdrawn male student who is initially against Misaki as the student council President because of her aspirations of increasing the female population of Seika High.
27717: The Student Council President at Miyabigaoka High School, he initially appears as a gentleman who marvels at Misaki and the changes she has brought to Seika High, offering her a chance to come to Miyabigaoka with an exceptional loan.
27718: The Vice President of the Student Council at Miyabigaoka High.
27719: A good friend of Misaki's and one of the few female students at Seika High, Sakura is friendly and cheerful and, like the rest of the girls, relies on Misaki for protection from the wild behaviour of the boys.
27913: One of Misaki and Sakura’s friends, a sensible and intelligent girl who often spends lunchtime with them. Shizuko is a member of the flower arranging club and is good at math, but isn’t very good at physical activities.
27914: Satsuki’s younger sister and Aoi's aunt, Nagisa is the manager of a beach house known as “Ocean House.”
27982: Misaki's younger sister. She is very apathetic and shows little to no emotion. She does not work at any part time jobs and appears to be in middle school. In the anime, she often enters magazine contests and always seems to win food prizes.
27984: Misaki's mother. She appears to be somewhat sickly, but does her best to support Misaki and Suzuna by working as a nurse at the hospital.
28084: The manager of Café Latte and Misaki’s boss; a 30-year-old woman who has a tendency to voice out her fantasies. She is a cheerful woman who enjoys her job because it allows her to make others happy.
28085: An employee at Café Latte. She can become somewhat maniacal about getting in character for her job and criticizes Misaki for her initial resistance to acting parts outside of her comfort range, as well as for being ashamed of working at Maid Latte and hiding it from her peers.
28086: A college student working at Café Latte. She notes that Misaki is strong and picks up work quickly, and claims that it doesn't feel like Misaki is younger than her. She has a tendency to eavesdrop and is described as having a "voice fetish." She is also proud of her bust.
28088: An employee at Café Latte. Like Honoka, she does not have a full-time job and makes a living from part-time work. She considers Misaki to be hard working. Subaru can be distinguished by her glasses.
28197: A male student at Seika High School who initially dislikes Misaki because of her forceful methods of reforming Seika.
29387: The third member of the "idiot trio" who frequent Cafe Maid Latte, nicknamed "Kurotatsu". Known for being the perverted one and likes "erotic things". Also used to be a delinquent in middle school with Shiroyan.
29739: The second of the "idiot trio", which includes Shirakawa Naoya and Ryuunosuke Kurosaki. A closet otaku, he is actually good at drawing manga illustrations, enjoys writing, and wants to be a mangaka. His friends call him "Ikkun".
32018: He attended the same middle school as Misaki.
32985: The bespectacled Miyabigaoka High School International Chess Club President who looks down upon Seika students.
33974: Kuuga is the vocalist of band UxMishi (ユメミシ, Yumemishi). While he seems sweet and kind to his fans, in reality he is very arrogant, rude and insensitive to others' feelings.
34127: He has been rejected by Sakura one hundred times.
34128: Commentator of Seika High Sports Festival. Broadcasting Head of the Student Council. One of the committee heads who is given much attention in the show.
34881: Assistant Clerk. Secretary of the Student Council.
35071: He appears in an extra chapter of the manga, in which it's revealed that he was Shirakawa's underclassman and that he looks up to his upperclassman because in the past he was saved by him.
35072: Bassist of UxMishi. Although he is part of the band, Kou is more down to earth and respects his fans. He is seemingly one of the closer people to the band's leader, Kuuga.
35075: Cleaning Rep who's always afraid of Misaki.
36624: Sports Executive of the Student Council.
36626: Culture Executive of the Student Council.
